title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：shadow　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shadow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the ranger ① casted the shadow that no villager in the valley would have described, and he said the casting was the whole of the season. The ② shadow, meaning the shade itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a shadow, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ shadow in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ shadow at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shadow, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the ranger said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shadow was the whole of the matter, meaning the fear and not the shade. The ⑥ shadow, meaning the fear and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; shadow, he said, is either something you cast or the only word that means both a shade and a fear. He said the fear is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ shadow had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ shadow of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of describing; shadow, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shadow I remember is the shade described in the survey, which closed in 1983 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ shadow, my mother said in 1985, is the only shade that improves by being described; every shadow, she said, is a fear that has agreed to look like a shade. She said the fear was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 影子；阴影（指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 影子；阴影（指那道影子本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：cast the shadow 投下这一道影子
D. n. 影子；阴影（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 影子之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的影子之事）
F. n. 影子；阴影（指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一道）
G. n. 影子、隐忧（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐忧（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: casted the shadow that no villager in the valley would have described
The shadow, meaning the shade itself and not the staff
the shadow at the far ridge
the shadow was the whole of the matter
the shadow had become a line in a survey
The shadow of the whole thing
A shadow, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: cast the shadow 意为“投下这一道影子”，1976 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一道影子做了一遍。
shadow 意为“影子；阴影”，指那道影子本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。
shadow 意为“影子；阴影”，指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
shadow 意为“影子；阴影”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shadow 意为“影子、隐忧”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道隐忧就是那件事的全部。
shadow 意为“隐忧”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道影子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shadow 意为“影子；阴影”，指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一道，到 1981 年这一道成了踏勘记录里的一行。
shadow 意为“影子之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的影子之事是一处山谷和三个季节的描述。
shadow 意为“影子；阴影”，我记得的是踏勘记录里描述过的那一道，1983 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一道。
shadow 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，影子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的影子。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位守林人投下了山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一道影子，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（cast the shadow）
那道影子，指的是那道影子本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。（shadow）
那处山谷里每一道影子旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（shadow）
最远那道山脊那道影子，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（shadow）
叔叔说这道隐忧就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那道影子。（shadow）
1985 年母亲说，影子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的影子。（shadow）
